verdict.rationale: Buzz is open source and self-hostable, and agents can search six months of history. Neither fact documents a free tier, a message-history retention policy, or a guarantee that older history stays accessible without paying. The self-hosting and search evidence is adjacent to this story and does not address free-tier history limits.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can keep my team on a free tier without losing access to older message history
